sn55.32:1.3: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.32:1.4: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.32:3.1: vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
sn55.32:3.3: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārāti.
